svg.title: Add noise to learn; remove it to create
svg.desc: Training: real pictures have more and more random noise added, step by step, and the model learns to predict the noise so it can take it away. Creating: it starts from pure noise and removes a little at a time, guided by your prompt, until a new picture appears.

g.text: TRAINING: ADD NOISE, STEP BY STEP
the model learns to predict the noise that was added
CREATING: START FROM NOISE, REMOVE IT STEP BY STEP
Your prompt ("a house on a sunny day") steers each clean-up step.
Usually 20 to 50 steps; made-up pictures here.
